story.title: Adam and the Big Red Car
story.goal: Practise asking a friend to join the play.
story: Adam loved his big red car. Every morning he drove it around the play mat.
One day Adam saw Lina building a tall garage with blocks.
Adam took a deep breath and said: "Can my car park in your garage?"
Lina smiled. "Yes! Let's build a ramp together." They played until lunch time.
questions: What did Adam want to do?
What could you build with a friend?
story.teacher_note: Read slowly and pause after Adam asks. Invite the child to show how they would ask.

activity.title: Car Wash Team
activity.goal: Take turns and share a role in a small group game.
instructions: Set up a car wash with two stations: wash and dry.
Invite two friends to join the child.
Each child chooses a station, then they swap after every car.
what_to_observe: Does the child invite a friend to swap?
How does the child wait for a turn?
activity.adaptation: Start with one friend and a clear picture card that shows whose turn it is.

video.title: Taking Turns at the Slide
video.script: Mia and Sam want the slide at the same time. They count to three and take turns.

multiple_choice.title: Car Friends
multiple_choice.intro: Let's help Adam play with friends.

rounds.question: Adam wants to play with Lina. What can he say?
rounds.explanation: Asking kindly helps friends say yes.

rounds.question: Lina is using the blue car. What can Adam do?
rounds.explanation: Waiting for a turn keeps the game fun for everyone.

rounds.question: Adam's tower fell down. How might he feel?
rounds.explanation: Many feelings are okay. We can build it again together.

rounds.question: Lina got a hug from her friend. How does she feel?
rounds.explanation: A hug from a friend can feel warm and happy.

rounds.question: Adam and Lina build a very tall tower. What happens next?

choices.label: They add one more block together
They knock it down on purpose

rounds.explanation: Building together makes the tower even taller!
